descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Welcome to ArmStrong VR — the ultimate VR fitness survival game designed for serious weight loss and full-body cardio!

Unlike games where you just stand still, ArmStrong VR turns your entire body into the controller. It is the ONLY VR game that integrates real physical exercises into its core survival mechanics. To escape danger, you must perform:
🏃‍♂️ Intense Arm-Sprints
🦘 Real Physical Jumps
🏋️‍♂️ Deep Squats
🌪️ Core Twists & Side Lunges
💪 Floor Push-Ups!

🔥 KEY FITNESS FEATURES:

• REAL WEIGHT LOSS (HIIT): Every dodge and sprint acts as High-Intensity Interval Training, directly melting fat and burning calories.
• INTERACTIVE FITNESS HUB: Track your exact burned calories and distance traveled in real-time on the new menu board.
• DAILY WORKOUTS: Choose your daily cardio challenge: Beginner (250m), Intermediate (500m), or Advanced (1km) to build your fitness streak!
• ENDLESS PROCEDURAL MODES: Escape a terrifying monster in a randomly generated Maze, or physically duck and lunge to dodge traffic in Street Mode.
• GLOBAL LEADERBOARDS: Test your vertical reflexes in the Jump Challenge and compete against players worldwide!

Are you ready to transform your body? Jump in, drop down, dodge obstacles, and start sweating!
